properties.name: Richmond Metro (Central Virginia)
properties.description: Richmond, Virginia and its close-in outdoors: the James River Park System threading the city (Belle Isle, Buttermilk, North Bank, Forest Hill), Pocahontas State Park to the south, Powhatan State Park to the west, and the James River riverfront east to Deep Bottom. Urban-fringe terrain — river-gorge singletrack, floodplain and piedmont-forest trails. A first cut centered on the metro; the bbox can widen later to reach Pocahontas/Powhatan more fully or add the upper James.
properties.bbox_comment: [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees (WGS84)
properties.min_fetch_counts_comment: Per-source raw-fetch floors (a source fetching below its floor aborts the run BEFORE any load/prune — a truncated/partial fetch can't self-wipe). Keys match registry source names (only OSM fetches geometry here; USGS is 3DEP elevation enrichment, which never fetches). Conservative lower bound sized to catch gross truncation without false-tripping. Env-overridable via ADVENTURE_FETCH_MIN_OSM.
